summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(str(self)) (prefix test); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only if a stored term URI equals ref under URIRef node-type-aware equality (plain strings and Literals are not members; container properties like rdf _1 are False); _RDFNamespace inherits it. Also changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to return dir(self.uri). Added NamespaceMembershipTest in test/test_namespace.py covering the spec's prefix, SH, RDFS, RDF, container, plain-string and Literal cases. Tests and doctests were NOT run (per instruction); verification was by reading only. No commits made. NamespaceManager left unchanged.
